# FunPlay Systems

> FunPlay Systems (Fun Play Systems Private Limited) is an Indian designer and manufacturer of outdoor playground equipment, outdoor gym equipment and garden furniture. Founded in 2002 by Suraj Shetty and based in Vasai East, Maharashtra, it runs a 45,000 sq ft factory with in-house design, rotational moulding and steel fabrication, employs 150+ people and has completed 15,000+ installations across India. Winner of a Red Dot Design Award (2024).

Key facts:
- Products: multi play stations, slides, swings, see saws, merry-go-rounds, spring riders, climbers, outdoor gym (open gym) equipment, benches, gazebos and pergolas.
- Ranges: CoreCraft (core themed and individual equipment), FunPlay Originals (in-house designer play structures inspired by Indian games, origami and nature), NexLev Series (premium wooden-finish play towers and adventure structures).
- Customers: schools and pre-schools, housing societies and builders, municipal corporations and government bodies, PSUs and corporates, hotels, resorts and clubs.
- Service: design, manufacture, delivery and installation across all Indian states; Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) and after-sales support.
- Warranty: 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope; 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts.
- Colour options: 12 colours in plastic parts and 7 in metal parts; custom themes available.
- Sales: +91 90283 02266, sales@funplaysystems.com. After-sales: +91 73853 00921, aftersales@funplaysystems.com.
- Address: Unit No. 5, S. Nanda Business Park, Survey No. 33/2, Shiv Shankar Road, Sagpada, Devdhal, Kaman Bhiwandi Road, Vasai East, District Palghar, Maharashtra 401208, India. Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM.
